<?php

const PASSAGE = "the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog the fox barks "
    . "and the dog sleeps while the fox runs";

function tokenise(string $text): array
{
    return explode(" ", trim($text));
}

function tally(array $words): array
{
    $counts = [];
    foreach ($words as $word) {
        $clean = strtolower(trim($word, ".,;:!?"));
        if ($clean === "") {
            continue;
        }
        if (isset($counts[$clean])) {
            $counts[$clean] += 1;
        } else {
            $counts[$clean] = 1;
        }
    }
    return $counts;
}

function leaderboard(array $counts, int $limit): array
{
    $pairs = [];
    foreach ($counts as $word => $count) {
        $pairs[] = [$word, $count];
    }
    usort($pairs, function ($a, $b) {
        if ($a[1] === $b[1]) {
            return strcmp($a[0], $b[0]);
        }
        return $b[1] <=> $a[1];
    });
    $kept = [];
    foreach ($pairs as $pair) {
        if (count($kept) >= $limit) {
            break;
        }
        $kept[] = $pair;
    }
    return $kept;
}

function toRoman(int $value): string
{
    $left = $value;
    $out = "";
    foreach (ROMAN_UNITS as $unit) {

        $rows[] = [$value, $text];
    }

        "count" => count($values)];
}

code:
<?php

const SAMPLE_TEXT = "aaabbccccdddeeffffgghhhhhh";

function encodeRuns(string $text): array
{
    $out = [];
    $length = strlen($text);
    if ($length === 0) {
        return $out;
    }
    $current = $text[0];
    $count = 1;
    for ($i = 1; $i < $length; $i++) {
        $ch = $text[$i];
        if ($ch === $current) {
            $count += 1;
        } else {
            $out[] = [$current, $count];
            $current = $ch;
            $count = 1;
        }
    }
    $out[] = [$current, $count];
    return $out;
}

function decodeRuns(array $pairs): string
{
    $out = "";
    foreach ($pairs as $pair) {
        $out .= str_repeat($pair[0], $pair[1]);
    }
    return $out;
}

function summariseRuns(string $text): array
{
    $pairs = encodeRuns($text);
    $longest = 0;
    $compact = "";
    foreach ($pairs as $pair) {
        if ($pair[1] > $longest) {
            $longest = $pair[1];
        }
        $compact .= $pair[0] . $pair[1];
    }
    return ["pairs" => $pairs, "runs" => count($pairs), "longest" => $longest,
        "compact" => $compact, "round_trip" => decodeRuns($pairs) === $text];
}

{
    $total = 0;
    $position = 1;
    foreach (str_split($body) as $ch) {

            continue;

        if ($ok) {
            $valid += 1;
        } else {

        $rows[] = [$text, $expected, $ok, $ok ? "ok" : "check " . $actual];
    }
    return ["rows" => $rows, "valid" => $valid, "invalid" => $invalid];
}

  end

end

def window_average(values, start, size)
  window = values[start, size]
  return nil if window.nil? || window.empty?

  total = 0
  window.each do |value|
    total += value
  end
  (total.to_f / window.length).round(2)
end

def moving_averages(values, size)
  return [] if size <= 0 || size > values.length

  out = []
  last_start = values.length - size
  (0..last_start).each do |start|
    average = window_average(values, start, size)
    next if average.nil?

    out << average
  end
  out
end
